selection: None - the builder owns its document model and emitter
rationale: The spike ran (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-01-grapesjs-spike-findings.md). GrapesJS was never load-bearing in the reference implementation: it is mounted 1x1 off-screen with no panels, fed setComponents on change and never read back, and its only observable effect is a status badge. The document model, the emitter, undo/redo, the canvas and the inspector are all the prototype's own code. Adopting the library would have bought nothing and would have voided the measured output evidence, since GrapesJS getHtml() was never tested and emits id and data-gjs-* attributes this pipeline strips. See ADR-039.
